title.narrative: Volunteer Medical Project for Orthopedic and Joint Replacement Surgery

description.narrative: 1) Provide medical services to low-income beneficiaries who cannot cover their treatment costs. 2) Perform surgical operations. 3) Supply patients' medication needs as required. 4) Ease the suffering of many patients. 5) Provide health education to all who receive treatment, for prevention. 6) Support the host country's Ministry of Health, which suffers from a shortage of medical staff.
Provision of medical services to low-income beneficiaries who are unable to cover the cost of their treatment.
